steps.message:
Before I touch it — this is a breaking API change, not just a field name.

`routes/users.js:6` returns `userId`, and `README.md:3-5` says `GET /users` has three consumers — the web app, iOS 3.2+, and the nightly partner export — and that field names are part of the contract, with changes going through a versioned endpoint. Renaming in place breaks any consumer reading `userId`, and the shipped iOS clients can't be updated in lockstep.

I haven't made any edit yet.
